description: AdventureWorks production schema. Questions from ../sample_questions_adv_prod.md; reference_sql is hand-written and run read-only, every reference value must appear in the answer.

questions.question: List all products in the Mountain product line.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT name FROM production.product WHERE productline = 'M'

questions.question: How many products are there in each color?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT color, COUNT(*) FROM production.product WHERE color IS NOT NULL GROUP BY color

questions.question: How many products are there in total?
How many products are manufactured in-house vs purchased?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE makeflag) AS in_house, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT makeflag) AS purchased FROM production.product

questions.question: Show all products available in size Large or Extra Large.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT name FROM production.product WHERE size IN ('L', 'XL')

questions.question: What is the average list price for Bikes vs Clothing vs Components vs Accessories?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT pc.name, ROUND(AVG(p.listprice), 2) FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = ps.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.name

questions.question: and what is the maximum list price for each?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT pc.name, MAX(p.listprice) FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = ps.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.name

questions.question: Show the total inventory quantity by product category.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT pc.name, SUM(pi.quantity) FROM production.productinventory pi JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pi.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = ps.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.name

questions.question: Plot the total inventory quantity by product category.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT pc.name, SUM(pi.quantity) FROM production.productinventory pi JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pi.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = ps.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.name

questions.question: What is the total quantity currently on each shelf in the Metal Storage location?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT pi.shelf, SUM(pi.quantity) FROM production.productinventory pi JOIN production.location l ON l.locationid = pi.locationid WHERE l.name = 'Metal Storage' GROUP BY pi.shelf

questions.question: For each product category, what is the average number of days to manufacture?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT pc.name, ROUND(AVG(p.daystomanufacture), 2) FROM production.product p JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory pc ON pc.productcategoryid = ps.productcategoryid GROUP BY pc.name

questions.question: For each location, show the total inventory value (quantity x product list price).

expect.reference_sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(pi.quantity * p.listprice) FROM production.productinventory pi JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = pi.productid JOIN production.location l ON l.locationid = pi.locationid GROUP BY l.name

questions.question: List all products that have had a price increase (multiple entries in list price history).

expect.reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM production.productlistpricehistory h JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = h.productid GROUP BY p.productid, p.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

questions.question: Find products that have zero inventory across all locations.

expect.reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM production.product p LEFT JOIN production.productinventory pi ON pi.productid = p.productid GROUP BY p.productid, p.name HAVING COALESCE(SUM(pi.quantity), 0) = 0

questions.question: What is the scrap rate (scrapped qty / order qty) by product subcategory for work orders?

expect.reference_sql: SELECT ps.name FROM production.workorder w JOIN production.product p ON p.productid = w.productid JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productsubcategoryid = p.productsubcategoryid GROUP BY ps.name
